description: This file contains SQL schema definitions, stored procedures, and query templates for managing the Orleans Grain Directory in a MySQL/MariaDB database. It defines the table structure for storing grain locations, and procedures for registering, unregistering, and looking up grain activations, including batch operations for multiple silo addresses.

methods.name: RegisterGrainActivation
methods.description: Procedure to insert or update a grain activation record in the OrleansGrainDirectory table.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivation
methods.description: Procedure to delete a specific grain activation record from the OrleansGrainDirectory table.

methods.name: LookupGrainActivation
methods.description: Procedure to retrieve a grain activation record based on cluster, provider, and grain IDs.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainActivations
methods.description: Procedure to batch delete grain activations associated with multiple silo addresses.
